Walmart Plus gets sold to you as “free delivery” and that’s like 20% of what’s actually in it.  Here are 4 things buried in the membership that have nothing to do with shipping, ranked from least to most slept-on.  4. Fuel savings - 10 cents off per gallon at Walmart, Exxon, Mobil, and Murphy stations, automatic, no activation needed.  3. Twenty-four seven vet access through an app called Pawp, included in your membership. Useful at 2am when your dog gets into something.  2. This one is brand new, like this-month new. Twenty-five free 4x6 photo prints every month, up to 300 a year. You order from the Photo Center and pull up your barcode on the Walmart+ benefits page before you check out. Walmart said something like 70 percent of the photos we take never get looked at again, and this fixes that for free.  1. Included streaming. You get to pick Paramount+ or Peacock at no extra cost, which is up to 109 dollars a year in savings if you’re already paying for one of those.  Comment if Walmart+ is worth it for your family!  #walmartplus #walmart #moneytips #PersonalFinance #familyfinance

You can get 24 7 access to a licensed vet from your phone with POP. It's included in your membership. Totally free. This is the perk that has zero overlap with what Walmart plus is advertised for, so it's the one families like yours and mine are most likely to have completely forgotten exists. And it's useful at 2:00am when your dog ate something it definitely shouldn't. Also, POP is working on getting the ability to prescribe pet medications. And are already available in seven states, with more coming soon. No.2 25 free photo prints every month. This is brand new. Walmart plus members now get 25 free 4 by 6 photo prints every month up to 300 a year. You just order from the Photo Center, then show your barcode from the Walmart plus benefits page right before checkout. This perk is so new that almost no current members know it. Exists yet and No. 1 included. Paramount plus or Peacock. You can choose either Paramount plus, essential or Peacock Premium at no extra cost. That's worth up to $109 a year in savings because it's a direct subscription overlap. Most families are already paying for one of these separately, so it's the single biggest you're paying twice moment on the list. On top of those, you have 25% off Burger King, one free whopper every quarter. You also get free flat tire repair and free road hazard warranty when buying new tires on top of the free delivery. Walmart plus is definitely worth the money for our family. What about you?
